summary: ctchou (Ching-Tsun Chou) is already a core CSLib contributor and authored the automata/omega-language stack underlying task 241; CSLib's code is his in-flight port of AutomataTheory. McNaughton's theorem (proof_wanted IsRegular.iff_da_muller in OmegaRegularLanguage.lean:260) is the last unported piece. Recommended path: adapt/complete the first-party port using the Choueka congruence-based proof, reusing CSLib's already-proved BuchiCongruence saturation machinery (same infrastructure that proves IsRegular.compl). Both projects are Apache 2.0, same author, identical types, so licensing/translation are non-issues. The hard (forward) determinization direction leverages existing lemmas (eq_fin_iSup_hmul_omegaPow, buchiFamily saturation, regular_omegaLim, Buchi.toMuller); the easy reverse direction needs a small Muller-to-NBA construction. Coordinate with Chou before independent reproof since his completed Lean proof exists.
